content: Shadows of the City Spurloc Crime Series . SERIES .  It always starts with a girl, Spurloc is tasked to investigate a cheating husband, but not just any cheating husband, James Danforth the third, one of the richest people in  Metroplex, soon he finds himself knee deep and the prime suspect in the man’s murder, the girl has disappeared and he has to solve the crime as even more evidence mounts against him, someone is framing him to take the fall for the murder of the century .  Elvis An Escaped AI that Spurloc Adopted and now helps him solve cases and is his  zaney  side kick .  Martin Spurloc Detective and Warlock Spurloc grew up in a house with police officers, a long family tradition he joined after high school, until one faithful day a bomb changed his life, half of his body was replaced with Cybernetics and he was discharged, with nothing else to do , Martin took his skills private and opened a detective agency. Along the way he adopted a wayward AI with the personality of a long dead rock star,  So  he and Elvis solve crimes in the city that even the police think are a lost  cause.
